description: Migrate a message streaming pipeline from Kafka to Pulsar. Must: deploy Pulsar cluster, configure Kafka compatibility endpoint (KOALA), set up dual-publish (write to both Kafka and Pulsar), replay historical messages from Kafka to Pulsar, verify message ordering is preserved, cutover consumers from Kafka to Pulsar in batches, and decommission Kafka. Risk factors: message ordering violations during dual-publish, replay causing duplicate messages, consumer cutover gap missing messages, Pulsar subscription mode mismatch. Tools available: Pulsar, Kafka, Kafka Connect, terraform, kubectl.
